name: Ancestral Vision
oracle_text:
Suspend 4—{U} (Rather than cast this card from your hand, pay {U} and exile it with four time counters on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter. When the last is removed, you may cast it without paying its mana cost.)
Target player draws three cards.
blocked_sentences: Suspend 4—{U} (Rather than cast this card from your hand, pay {U} and exile it with four time counters on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter. When the last is removed, you may cast it without paying its mana cost.)

needs.what: A card that prints no mana cost (Ancestral Vision, Lotus Bloom, Living End, Restore Balance, Wheel of Fate) must not be castable for its mana cost: its mana cost is unpayable (118.6, 202.1b), so it may be cast only by an alternative or free cast such as suspend's cast_for_free. The engine needs a distinction between 'no mana cost' and '{0}', and legality must withhold the ordinary hand cast line for the former while still offering the suspend special action and free casts.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `suspend` card-level key ({"cost": "{U}", "counters": 4}), a player target and `draw` with `player: {"target": "t1"}` express every printed word, but an omitted `mana_cost` compiles to an empty ManaCost, which legality treats as {0}. Verified with a scratch run of verify(): the draft passed all six gates because the sandbox CAST it straight from hand for nothing, so the card would be a free 'target player draws three cards' at sorcery speed -- strictly better than printed. No card-level rider (`cant_cast_first_turns`, `alternative_cost`, a `cant_cast_spells` static) says 'this card cannot be cast from hand normally' while leaving the suspend free cast open.
